_comment: Name the Duco blocks after the box they actually speak to.
Node 1 of the connected system answers INPUT parameter 0 with module type 10,
Registers.pdf, L8000009) decodes as DucoBox Focus.
The name matters because the master node's register block is model-specific.
This block reads six INPUT registers from address 10, and on a Focus those are
type / status / ventilation position / current power / average power / maximum
power. A DucoBox Energy or Silent Connect answers the same addresses with a
different set, so a block claiming to be a generic DUCOBOX would be publishing
mislabelled numbers on any of them.
The node block is renamed to match: it is only ever instantiated by the box
block, as ARRAY[2..30] OF <node type>, and a pair whose names diverge invites
someone to reuse the node against a different box.
Instance names are NOT renamed. The MQTT topic is derived from the instance
name, so renaming GVL_RS485.FB_RS485_DUCO_DUCOBOX_HOME would move every topic
it publishes and orphan the retained state behind it.
